pattern: filter, derive a comparable percentage, rank
question: make district list for 2023 coverage percentage and sort best first
gold_sql: SELECT district, ROUND(100.0 * children_fully_immunised / children_due, 1) AS coverage_percent FROM immunisation WHERE year = 2023 ORDER BY coverage_percent DESC, district
sql_duckdb: SELECT T1.district, CAST(T1.anc4_completed AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(NULLIF(T2.pregnancies_registered, 0), 0) AS coverage_percentage FROM anc_visits AS T1 INNER JOIN maternal_services AS T2 ON T1.district = T2.district AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.year = 2023 ORDER BY coverage_percentage DESC
